en.title: Unknown is not zero
en.text: Missing or conflicting metrics remain unknown. A proven empty window can return zero. Daily count, duration and energy require verified selection; duration and energy reconcile independently. Zero-distance average consumption is undefined. Inspect per-metric quality before drawing a conclusion.

zh-Hans.title: 未知不等于零
zh-Hans.text: 缺失或冲突指标保持未知；已验证的空周期才可返回零。每日次数、时长和能耗需要已校验的记录范围，时长和能耗分别核对。零里程的平均能耗无定义。先检查逐指标质量。

en.title: Business dates and period boundaries
en.text: Rides belong wholly to their Asia/Shanghai end date, without invented midnight allocation. Adjacent-month evidence may be needed. New days and months never inherit previous-period totals. Cached same-period entity values do not establish completeness for strict historical statistics.

zh-Hans.title: 业务日期与周期边界
zh-Hans.text: 行程整体归入上海时区的结束日期，不按午夜虚构拆分；月边界可能需要相邻月份证据。新日或新月不会继承旧周期总量。实体保留同周期缓存值并不代表严格历史统计已经完整。

en.title: Waiting for the local request budget
en.text: Month pages and detail requests share the durable account budget, normally 60 logical calls/hour. Waiting for budget is local scheduling, not an application for cloud permission. Inspect next_request_at, retry_at, phase and errors; repeated full scans do not replenish it. Zero disables only the hourly quota, not serialization or upstream backoff.

zh-Hans.title: 等待本地请求额度
zh-Hans.text: 月份页与详情共享账号耐久预算，通常每小时60次逻辑请求。等待额度是本地调度，不是申请云端权限。检查next_request_at、retry_at、阶段和错误；反复全量扫描不会补充额度。零仅取消小时配额，不取消串行和上游退避。

en.title: Different history coverage denominators
en.text: Month scan, returned list coverage and saved details describe different sets. Saved-detail 100% covers discovered ride IDs, not undiscovered cloud rides or full geometry. Visited months are not automatically verified. A successful request is distinct from completion; inspect last_success and last_completed separately.

zh-Hans.title: 历史覆盖率的分母不同
zh-Hans.text: 月份扫描、返回列表覆盖率和详情保存率对应不同集合。详情100%只覆盖已发现行程，不证明未发现的云端行程或完整轨迹。访问过月份不等于已校验。一次请求成功与任务完成不同，分别检查last_success与last_completed。

en.title: Select a verified saved detail
en.text: Use ride_id and query_month from the selected vehicle’s recorded-trip list. Assistant detail reads use the local archive only; missing details are not fetched from the cloud. Read one bounded date page, follow its next cursor and distinguish page size from period totals. Normal history synchronization acquires missing details separately.

zh-Hans.title: 选择已校验的本地详情
zh-Hans.text: 从所选车辆的已保存行程列表取得ride_id和query_month。Assistant详情仅查本地档案，不会为缺失详情请求云端。按有界日期分页并跟随next cursor，页内条数不等于周期总数。缺失详情由正常历史同步另行获取。

en.title: Query time and observation time
en.text: Query as_of is when the local projection was requested, not a new cloud measurement. Use group observation timestamps and freshness for cached current state, and per-metric quality for missing values. Closed-month age alone does not make historical facts stale. ACC does not prove movement; a seat-latch state does not prove the lid is open.

zh-Hans.title: 查询时间与观测时间
zh-Hans.text: query as_of表示请求本地投影的时间，不是新的云端观测。当前缓存值应连同分组观测时间、新鲜度及逐指标质量解释。已结束月份仅因时间久不会使历史事实过期。ACC不证明移动，座桶锁舌状态不证明盖子打开。

en.title: Preserve measurement semantics
en.text: Server maximum speed is different from overall average speed calculated from distance and duration. Unknown sample units stay unverified. Use returned units rather than guessing. Battery score is not SOH or a health diagnosis. Do not infer movement, maintenance advice or charging energy from incomplete samples.

zh-Hans.title: 保留指标语义与单位
zh-Hans.text: 服务端最高速度不同于距离除以时长的总平均速度；未知采样单位仍待验证，应使用工具返回单位。电池评分不是SOH或健康诊断。不从不完整采样推断移动、维修建议或充电能量。

en.title: Collect a safe sign-in failure report
en.text: For an existing account, use the integration menu’s Enable debug logging, reproduce once, then disable and download the log. Before setup, use the guide’s native logger steps and note the support identifier, form error and versions. A local proxy status does not prove a cloud region or internal authentication cause. Share no credentials, account value or vehicle/location data.

zh-Hans.title: 收集安全的登录故障信息
zh-Hans.text: 已有账号使用集成菜单的启用调试日志，复现一次后关闭并下载。添加前失败按指南使用原生日志步骤，记录support编号、表单错误和版本。本地代理状态不证明云端地区或内部认证原因。反馈不包含凭据、账号值或车辆位置。

en.title: Protect saved history and geometry
en.text: The account SQLite archive keeps normalized facts and redacted compressed business evidence without an automatic TTL, subject to quota, disk and backup settings. Better saved geometry survives a newer simplified or empty response. Observations around 180 days are not a server guarantee. Quota exhaustion pauses writes instead of silently evicting rides. Keep exports private.

zh-Hans.title: 保护已保存的历史和轨迹
zh-Hans.text: 账号SQLite保留标准化事实及已去身份的压缩业务证据，无自动TTL，仍受配额、磁盘和备份设置限制。新简化或空响应不能覆盖更好的已保存轨迹。180天附近的观察不是云端保证。超额暂停写入，不静默驱逐行程；导出文件需私密保管。

en.title: Assistant access is separate consent
en.text: Assistant defaults off. An active administrator, account consent and selected vehicle are checked on every read and before return. not_authorized means access denied, not that a ride is missing; stop that read and review Home Assistant permissions. Tools do not return credentials, account identifiers, raw logs or precise GPS. Turning consent off cannot retract data already sent to a chosen model host.

zh-Hans.title: Assistant使用独立授权
zh-Hans.text: Assistant默认关闭，每次读取及返回前检查有效管理员、账号同意和车辆选择。not_authorized表示权限拒绝，不能据此判断行程不存在；停止该读取并检查HA权限。工具不返回凭据、账号标识、原始日志或精确GPS。关闭授权无法撤回已发送给模型宿主的数据。

en.title: Choose a vehicle before reading measurements
en.text: With several vehicles, select one explicitly before asking for measurements. Obtain its opaque vehicle_ref from get_vehicles. Account numbers, serial numbers and the MCP client-origin device_id are not substitute references. Query capability does not identify the intended vehicle.

zh-Hans.title: 查询数值前选择车辆
zh-Hans.text: 多辆车时，先明确选择一辆，再询问实测值。用get_vehicles取得不透明vehicle_ref；账号、序列号和MCP客户端来源device_id不能替代。查询能力也不能确定用户要查哪辆。

en.title: Request review of missing trip details
en.text: From 2.1.2, the separate Ninebot tasks API offers local gap preview and an explicit application for human review. Enable account task consent and select allowed vehicles first. Preview at most 31 business days; freeze at most 20 mapped missing details. The total logical attempt allowance is twice the selected count, capped at 20, with shared account pacing. Applications do not query the cloud. The original requester must open Ninebot Assistant in HA with the same user, review the exact scope and approve separately. A read-only MCP server hides the application tool.

zh-Hans.title: 申请审核缺失行程详情
zh-Hans.text: 从 2.1.2 起，独立 Ninebot tasks API 提供本地预览和明确的人工审核申请。先开启账号任务功能并选择车辆；最多预览 31 个业务日，冻结最多 20 条已映射的缺失详情。总逻辑尝试上限为选中条数两倍、最多 20 次，共享账号请求间隔。申请不查询云端。原申请人须使用同一个 HA 用户去 Ninebot Assistant 面板核对范围后另行批准；MCP 只读模式隐藏申请工具。

en.title: Understand a history task checkpoint
en.text: Task reads return only the original requester’s local task state for an authorized vehicle. Approval and queueing do not prove saved detail. Completion verifies each selected private payload; progress values describe the last durable checkpoint, with null meaning unobserved rather than zero. Attempts are conservative logical endpoint attempts, not all transport HTTP exchanges. Respect account pacing, retry_at and the 24-hour execution window. Normal restarts revalidate approved work; official HA backup restores require fresh human approval. Notifications only link to the panel; use task metadata for the result. Cancellation is performed by the requester in the panel and does not stop other tasks.

zh-Hans.title: 理解历史任务进度记录
zh-Hans.text: 任务查询只读原申请人获准车辆的本地状态；批准和排队不代表详情已保存。完成须逐条核验私有详情，数值代表最近持久记录，null 是尚未观察而非零。尝试计数是保守的逻辑端点尝试，不是全部底层 HTTP 交换数。遵守账号间隔、retry_at 和 24 小时执行期限。普通重启重验后恢复批准工作；官方 HA 备份恢复须重新人工批准。通知仅提供面板入口，结果以任务元数据为准；取消由原申请人在面板操作，不停止其他任务。

en.title: Select a vehicle
steps: Read the permitted roster once.
Ask which vehicle; wait for the answer.
en.stop: Do not pick the first vehicle or infer selection from cached_status.
en.verify: One explicit eligible vehicle before any measurement.

zh-Hans.title: 选择车辆
steps: 读取一次已授权车辆列表。
询问具体车辆，等待用户回答。
zh-Hans.stop: 不能默认第一辆，不能凭cached_status推断选择。
zh-Hans.verify: 查询实测值前得到唯一的已授权车辆。

en.title: Read current state
steps: Read cached status once.
Report known values, units and group observation time/freshness.
en.stop: Do not refresh cloud or infer lid position or motion.
en.verify: Null remains unknown; query as_of is not the measurement time.

zh-Hans.title: 读取当前状态
steps: 读取一次缓存状态。
按已知值、单位和分组观测时间/新鲜度回答。
zh-Hans.stop: 不刷新云端，不推断盖子状态或车辆移动。
zh-Hans.verify: null保留未知，query as_of不是实测时间。

en.title: Read period statistics
steps: Ask for a missing period; use Asia/Shanghai business dates.
Read statistics and preserve per-metric quality and units.
en.stop: Do not turn missing values into zero or partial values into complete totals.
en.verify: State vehicle, date range, source and coverage.

zh-Hans.title: 查询周期统计
steps: 缺少周期时先追问，使用上海业务日期。
读取统计，保留逐指标质量和单位。
zh-Hans.stop: 不把缺失当零，不把部分值当完整总量。
zh-Hans.verify: 说明车辆、日期范围、来源和覆盖情况。

en.title: Find a saved trip
en.trigger: User asks for saved trips or detail.
steps: Read one bounded local page; follow a returned cursor only when needed.
Use that vehicle’s ride_id/query_month for a saved scalar detail.
en.stop: Stop on access denial; missing detail never triggers a cloud fetch.
en.verify: A page is not a period total; preserve missing versus saved detail.

zh-Hans.title: 查找已保存行程
zh-Hans.trigger: 查询已保存行程或详情。
required_inputs: 明确日期或所选行程/月
steps: 读取一页有界本地记录，仅在需要时跟随返回游标。
用该车辆的ride_id/query_month读取本地标量详情。
zh-Hans.stop: 权限拒绝立即停止，缺失详情不触发云查询。
zh-Hans.verify: 一页不是周期总量，区分未保存和已有详情。

en.title: Explain unknown statistics
steps: Read statistics and its metric reason/coverage.
Read sync health if needed; retrieve matching public help.
en.stop: Explain observed conditions only; do not guess a root cause or fill zero.
en.verify: Cite period, reason, source and a bounded next step.

zh-Hans.title: 解释统计未知
steps: 读取统计及逐指标原因/覆盖。
必要时读取同步健康，检索对应公开帮助。
zh-Hans.stop: 只解释已观察条件，不猜根因，不补零。
zh-Hans.verify: 引用周期、原因、来源和有界下一步。

en.title: Inspect synchronization coverage
en.trigger: User asks about waiting or missing details.
steps: Read sync health and scheduling/coverage denominators.
Use one local page or matching help when needed.
en.stop: Do not start sync or change budget; saved 100% is not full cloud history.
en.verify: Separate discovered, saved, unmapped and verified; include next/retry time.

zh-Hans.title: 检查同步和缺口
zh-Hans.trigger: 询问同步等待或缺失详情。
steps: 读取同步健康，核对调度及覆盖率分母。
按需读取一页本地记录或对应帮助。
zh-Hans.stop: 不启动同步或修改额度，保存100%不是全云历史。
zh-Hans.verify: 区分发现、保存、映射与校验，说明下次/重试时间。

en.title: Guide authentication support
en.trigger: Authentication or connection failure is reported.
steps: Read a reported local health state when available.
Retrieve the versioned debug/support procedure.
en.stop: Do not request credentials, sign in or infer region/cause from a proxy status.
en.verify: Separate needs_login from retry; request only reviewed support metadata.

zh-Hans.title: 指导认证排障
required_inputs: 已观察错误或安装版本
steps: 有证据时读取本地健康状态。
检索对应版本的调试/支持步骤。
zh-Hans.stop: 不索要凭据，不登录，不凭代理状态猜地区或根因。
zh-Hans.verify: 区分需登录与等待重试，仅索取已审阅的支持信息。

en.title: Explain measurement semantics
en.trigger: User asks about a unit or interpretation.
steps: Use the relevant local result if a value is needed.
Retrieve documented semantics and cite the matching source.
en.stop: Unknown sample units/CRS stay unverified; no health diagnosis.
en.verify: Separate server maximum, distance/duration average and sample values.

zh-Hans.title: 解释指标语义
required_inputs: 私有事实需选择车辆/行程
steps: 需要具体值时读取对应本地结果。
检索文档语义并引用对应来源。
zh-Hans.stop: 未知采样单位/坐标系保持待验证，不做健康诊断。
zh-Hans.verify: 区分服务端最高速度、距离/时长平均和采样值。

en.title: Apply for a bounded detail task
en.trigger: User explicitly asks to apply for synchronization of missing trip details.
required_inputs: Ninebot tasks API exposed and account task consent enabled
Selected authorized vehicle and explicit business dates
steps: If task tools are absent, explain enabling them and stop. Use task_vehicles; ask when several vehicles are ambiguous.
Preview the selected dates. Report local coverage, missing selection, total attempt cap and expiry; missing history is not zero.
Only on explicit intent, apply for human review. A matching existing task can be returned; preserve its actual state. The application makes no cloud request.
If approval_required is true, ask the original requester to review in HA’s Ninebot Assistant panel with the same HA user. Never ask for a token; do not seek new approval for already approved work.
en.stop: Stop for missing inputs, denied access, no executable local selection or scope/budget uncertainty; do not expand the range or poll.
en.verify: Report the persisted task ID, returned state, range, selection and cap. Dedup returns existing work; acceptance alone proves neither approval nor saved detail.

zh-Hans.title: 申请有界详情同步任务
zh-Hans.trigger: 用户明确要求申请同步缺失的行程详情。
required_inputs: 已暴露 Ninebot tasks API，且账号已开启任务功能
明确的获准车辆与业务日期范围
steps: 缺少任务工具时说明开启方式并停止。用 task_vehicles 选车，多车歧义先询问。
预览指定日期，说明本地覆盖、待取条数、总尝试上限和有效期；缺历史不等于零。
仅在用户明确要求时申请人工审核；可能返回匹配的已有任务，应保留其真实状态，申请不查询云端。
仅 approval_required 为 true 时，请原申请人用同一个 HA 用户去 Ninebot Assistant 面板审核；不能索要凭据或要求重复批准已获准工作。
zh-Hans.stop: 输入缺失、拒绝访问、没有可执行的本地选择或范围/额度不明时停止；不扩大范围或循环查询。
zh-Hans.verify: 返回持久任务 ID、实际返回状态、范围、条数和上限；去重返回已有工作，受理本身不能证明批准或详情已保存。

en.title: Check a saved task result
en.trigger: User asks about an applied history task, its wait, result or cancellation.
required_inputs: Original requester’s HA identity and selected authorized vehicle
Task ID from a matching task list, or permission to list local tasks
steps: Use the selected task reference; if absent, list the requester’s tasks for the selected vehicle and ask which one when ambiguous.
Read the matching task once. Report state, last checkpoint, saved/selected count, actual attempt consumption, reason and next eligible time.
For waiting/retry states, respect retry_at and expiry; do not repeatedly poll or infer remaining hourly tokens. Unknown observations stay unknown.
For approval or cancellation, direct the same requester to the HA panel. New work requires a new explicit application and human approval.
en.stop: Stop on denied access or missing task. Missing is not completed; a task read cannot resume, approve, cancel or refresh cloud data.
en.verify: Only completed is verified completion. Distinguish partial/failed/cancelled/expired, null versus zero, conservative task attempts and saved checkpoint time.

zh-Hans.title: 核对已保存的任务结果
zh-Hans.trigger: 用户询问已申请任务的等待原因、结果或取消方式。
required_inputs: 原申请人的 HA 身份与选定的获准车辆
匹配任务列表中的任务 ID，或允许读取本地列表
steps: 优先使用已选任务；缺少时列出该用户该车的本地任务，多条有歧义先询问。
只读一次匹配任务，说明状态、最近记录、已保存/选中条数、实际尝试消耗、原因和下次允许时间。
等待或重试时遵守 retry_at 和期限，不循环查询或推断整小时剩余额度；未观察不补零。
需要批准或取消时指引原申请人去 HA 面板；新工作须另行明确申请并人工批准。
zh-Hans.stop: 拒绝访问或任务缺失时停止；缺失不是完成，读取不能恢复、批准、取消或刷新云端。
zh-Hans.verify: 仅 completed 代表核验完成；区分部分/失败/取消/过期、null 与零、保守尝试计数及最近持久记录时间。
